Upgrades are best done early, +1-866-829-1280(US) as they are rarely handled on board. While you can try to change  rooms +1-866-829-1280(US) or +44-204-586-5316(UK) at Guest Services after boarding, it is not guaranteed and depends on capacity. Best Method: Call Windstar Cruises directly +1-866-829-1280(US) your travel agent to make changes to your booking. Upgrade Costs: You will typically have +1-866-829-1280(US) to pay the difference between your current Cabin or room and the new one. Onboard Changes: While some cruisers report success +1-866-829-1280(US) changing rooms at Guest Services upon boarding, others note that, according to Windstar Cruises help page, it is hard to change, +1-866-829-1280(US) as ships often sail at full capacity.
